info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Chemical Engineering

description.describe_ch: 複合材料是一門結合高分子樹脂、纖維補強材、工具、製造技術、環境效益、品保檢測及各式應用的統整性學科。其目的在於：(一)了解複合材料的特性、熟悉其工具與製程；(二)了解複合材料的環境效應、品保檢測和結構修補；(三)了解複合材料的創新性技術及應用。
description.describe_eh: Composite technology is an interdisciplinary course that involving resin, fiber, tooling, manufacturing, environmental effect, quality assurance and repair, etc. The purpose of the course is: (1) To understand the characteristic of composite materials, composite tooling and manufacturing technology (2) To understand the characteristic of environmental effect, quality assurance and repair (3) To understand the innovative technology, future application and development of composite.

targets.describe_ch: 能定義何謂複合材料，描述其特性、工具、製程、應用及未來的發展性
targets.describe_en: Define composite technology with their own words: Be able to describe their characteristics, tooling, manufacturing, application and the future.

targets.describe_ch: 能瞭解並說明複合材料在產業應用層面的重要性及影響
targets.describe_en: Understand and be able to explain the importance and effects of composite to the society and economy.

targets.describe_ch: 能針對一特定有關複合材料的專題，設計一合理的製程規劃，並適切歸納出結論
targets.describe_en: Design a reasonable project for a specific composite product, conduct the flow chart, and draw appropriate conclusions.
